metadata.name: JsonSchema
metadata.description: A named data shape written as JSON Schema, usable as an input, output or field type anywhere without an import. It may extend other shapes and carry business rules — expressions over the value that must hold, each failing validation with its own code.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: JSON Schema definition for the declared data type.

extends.title: Extends
extends.description: Parent type name or list of parent type names to inherit from.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: CEL-based business invariant rules. Each rule's condition must return true for valid data.

condition.description: CEL expression evaluated with 'this' bound to the data. Must return true for valid data.
condition.x-telo-unbound-calls: a type rule's condition is evaluated against the value alone, wherever the shape is checked, where no module's functions are bound

code.description: Machine-readable error code surfaced on validation failure.

message.description: Optional human-readable hint for the validation failure.
